{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}{Combat Effect Chance}%{/c}
{/if}{c_label}Passive:{/c} Gain {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} every {c_number}[{SF_15}|1|]{/c} seconds.

{c_label}Active:{/c} Encase yourself, becoming {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} and gaining {c_number}[{SF_16}*100|%+|]{/c} Block Chance for {c_number}{buffduration:TIMER}{/c} seconds.
While {c_important}Armored Hide{/c} is active, gain {c_number}[{SF_10}*100|%+|]{/c} Blocked Damage Reduction.
{c_important}Armored Hide's{/c} Passive increases your Thorns by {c_number}[SF_32 * 100|%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Armored Hide{/c} also grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_2 * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * {SF_2})]){/c} for {c_number}[SF_3]{/c} |4second:seconds;.
{c_important}Armored Hide{/c} active duration is increased by {c_number}[SF_34]{/c} |4second:seconds;.
{c_important}Armored Hide{/c} restores {c_number}[{SF_18}]{/c} Vigor and makes you {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} for the duration.

When you Evade through enemies with {c_important}Armored Hide{/c} active, you deal {c_number}[{SF_11}*100|%|]{/c} of your Thorns to them. Activating {c_important}Armored Hide{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_12}*100|%|]{/c} of your Thorns to Close enemies.
